notes.title: The Jackbox Naughty Pack update is out now!
notes.content:
https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/54701168033359271/2CF2538404F5ABEFD8517A5227C3A809A0A15861/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false

We’re launching a free update for all Naughty Pack players with quality of life improvements, new content, and some changes to gameplay.

The update includes:
Additional Prompts: Fakin’ It All Night Long, Dirty Drawful, and Let Me Finish all have brand new prompts added to play with your foul-mouthed friends
New Content Filters: Fakin’ It All Night Long and Let Me Finish allow players to increase the intensity of the content they will see in their game. Too spicy? We got you! Not spicy enough? We also got you!
New Let Me Finish Mode: Quick Mode is coming to Let Me Finish! This mode allows you to add captions to photos and pits players against each other in rapid head-to-head rounds 
Optional Emotes: Dirty Drawful emotes can now be turned off in the settings. Why you wouldn’t want our Audio Lead, Kelly, moaning over all of your drawings is a surprise to us, but we hear you and it is now optional <3
Quality of Life Updates and Bug Fixes: This includes updated timers in Let Me Finish that allow players more time to create their saucy little masterpiece
Wishlist or buy now, and launch it with the free Megapicker!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2828500/The_Jackbox_Megapicker/

notes.title: Content Update Coming To The Jackbox Naughty Pack Fall 2024!
notes.content:
We’re launching a free update for all Naughty Pack players this fall to help you close out the year in spicy fashion, including new additions to all three games! 🌶️

This update will include:
 Additional prompts for Fakin’ It All Night Long, Dirty Drawful, and Let Me Finish
 New content filters in Fakin’ It All Night Long and Let Me Finish that allow players to increase the intensity of the content they will see in their game
 A brand new Quick Mode for Let Me Finish that allows you to add captions to photos and pits players against each other in rapid head-to-head rounds 
 The ability to turn off emotes in Dirty Drawful

Stay tuned here and on all Jackbox Games social channels so that you don’t miss out when the update goes live!

notes.title: Play The Jackbox Survey Scramble Today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2948640/The_Jackbox_Survey_Scramble/

Jackbox has made an all-new party experience! Taking real surveys from real people around the globe, The Jackbox Survey Scramble is constantly changing based on answers submitted from players, including you! Invite your friends, family, coworkers, and enemies to see how they think when it comes to questions like, “In one word, what’s the cutest nickname for butts?” or “In one word, what’s the best sandwich topping?”

Multiple New Game Modes
 Hilo: Can you guess the most popular one-word cat names? How about the least? In Hilo, compete to find the most and least popular answers to a wide variety of questions. The rankings may surprise you! It turns out a lot of people named their cat Frank. That's a freebie.
 Speed: In the fast-paced Speed, think on your toes to uncover as many answers on the list as possible, as quickly as possible. It’s everyone for themselves in a race against the clock! Each round the points increase, and the stakes get a little higher! Can you handle it?
 Squares: Two teams compete to claim three squares in a row on the grid. Guess popular choices for the first squares, semi-popular choices for the middle squares, and least popular choices for the final squares. We guarantee, you've never had a more heated argument over attractive fictional characters than you will playing Squares.
 Bounce: In Bounce, two teams control a paddle that sits on a scale between most popular-to-least popular answers. Work with your team to guess an answer that puts your paddle in the right place to intercept a bouncing ball and stop your opponents from scoring a goal! But be careful! The ball gets faster with each answer!
But wait… there’s more! We’ll be releasing a free game update featuring two new game modes in a couple months 👀 So what are you waiting for? Get The Jackbox Survey Scramble now for just $9.99 USD.



Play with your phone or tablet - no special controller required. All games support 2 to 8 players and 10,000 audience members. All Jackbox Survey Scramble games can be played in English, French, Italian, German, Castilian or Latin American Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese. And we'll be making sure we have localized answers for the UK and Australia, as well.
